name: atrium

scripts.electron:prod: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.icon: python3 build/make-icon.py && { command -v iconutil >/dev/null && iconutil -c icns build/icon.iconset -o build/icon.icns || echo 'skipped .icns (iconutil is macOS-only)'; }
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run electron:build && electron-builder --linux

description: A desktop workspace for running several coding agents in parallel
